title: Wang's belongings removed from his house after death

tellings.quote: Yeah, I think they came also came and uh took a bunch of stuff out of his house when he died.

plain: When a man named Eric Henry Wang died, people came and took a lot of things out of his house, according to the writer and researcher Greg Bishop. Bishop says it briefly on Michels' show, without naming a source or saying who "they" were, and the hint is that someone wanted whatever Wang had kept.
